stemMd: What is the product of the real solutions of x⁴ − 5x² + 4 = 0?
explanationMd: Set t = x² to get t² − 5t + 4 = (t − 1)(t − 4). Thus x is −2, −1, 1 or 2. Their product is 4. Keeping both signs when taking square roots is essential.

distractorRationale.a: There are two negative roots, so their sign contributions cancel.
distractorRationale.b: This is the sum of the two values of x², not the requested product.
distractorRationale.d: This multiplies only the positive roots.
distractorRationale.e: Zero does not satisfy the equation.
